Audio Joiner

Merge several audio files end-to-end into one WAV download.

    Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

    📖 How to use

    1. Drop multiple audio files into the tool.
    2. Check the file list and total duration.
    3. Click Download WAV to save the joined track.

    ❓ Frequently asked questions

    How are the files joined?

    Each file is decoded and the samples are concatenated in the order you selected them, keeping the original sample rate and channels.

    Can I see the total duration?

    Yes — the tool shows each file's duration and the combined total before you export.

    What format is the download?

    A 16-bit PCM WAV, the most compatible lossless format.
